objective: Align DSH STORE's package contract and compatibility evidence with the official DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 release without changing DSH source, official packages, inventory, Profile state, or ~/.dsh.

sourceReview.result: DSH STORE uses webServer, settings.section, settings.plugins.tab, shell.overlay, runtime status, and official CLI seams. DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 Session V3, Inbox, ctx.agent, and main/sidebar panel changes do not intersect this bundle.

postconditions: package.json declares version 0.8.17, DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 compatibility, published UI peer ranges, and the DSH 0.1.5 Node floor.
README and contract tests describe the official latest-three window including 0.1.5-rc.1.
the source review records the release Commit and keeps real Profile/runtime acceptance separate.
source changes are submitted through a CI-checked pull request before Catalog self-pinning.
rollback: Close or abandon the source PR; restore the exact precondition files from the base Commit. Do not reset author-contact-state, delete history, or mutate DSH Profile/~/.dsh.
confirmation: Source upgrade is authorized by the user's explicit DSH upgrade request; no Profile or package installation confirmation is included.
